data.narrative:
Lumotive is a Series B semiconductor company that has raised $72M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of eight private and three public semiconductor/chip companies at similar or adjacent stages, including Positron AI, SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, d-Matrix, and DEEPX.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $72M capital raised proxy, implying a valuation of $137M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range spanning $529M (DEEPX, Series C) to $11.0B (SambaNova, Series A). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied; while semiconductor public comps trade at a median 20.5x revenue (ALAB, NVDA, AMD), Lumotive's revenue is not disclosed.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range of $116M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.1B. This dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty around Lumotive's revenue trajectory and competitive positioning within the frontier-chip segment. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively to capital deployed; the peer-median approach reflects elevated valuations across the private semiconductor cohort, particularly at Series A. Resolution of this range hinges on clarity around Lumotive's revenue run-rate, gross margins, and competitive differentiation relative to the peer set.
